fields.title: Column
fields.description: The column whose values should be counted.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Enable hiliting
fields.description:
Enables hiliting between the distinct values in the output table and the corresponding rows in the
input table. Be aware that this may require a lot of memory if the table is large.
